notes.title: Small Update V2.3.1
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=cgVDSM78Gps;full][/previewyoutube]

This update modifies many parameters in the game,

[h1][b]AI Updated[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Increased the strength of the AI in the game, but each level will activate a part of the Titan's skills to achieve balance.
[*] Increased the number of teammates in the story mode and the improve the strength, health.
[/list]

[h1][b]Player Updated[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] The player's health has been greatly increased, it is no longer a pitiful 5 health at the start.
[*] 3D map moved to the middle. (including the main world)
[*] Press J to open the tutorial panel anytime and anywhere.
[*] Pressing H now hides the UI normally.
[/list]

[h1][b]Map Updated[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] 1st level reworked.
[*] 2nd level reworked.
[*] Now the story mode map will automatically jump to the next chapter.
[*] The probability of entering the back room map is reduced.
[/list]

[h1][b]Game Fix[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fix the problem that the second level cannot be opened.
[/list]

notes.title: Updates V2.2.5.5
notes.notes:
[h2]Improved:[/h2]
[list]
[*] The second chapter greatly improves the fluency
[*] UI performance improvements
[*] Achievement menu UI reworked
[*] 3D maps are no longer harsh yellow
[/list]

[h2]Added:[/h2]
[list]
[*] NPC and player character names
[*] Hostile unit health bar UI
[*] Hostile turret health bar UI
[*] Friendly unit health bar UI
[*] Friendly Turret Health Bar UI
[*] Player health bar UI
[*] HP level (yellow number to the left of character name)

[/list]

[h2]Updated:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Now players can no longer restore more health
[*] XENRO No. 1 data can no longer be directly accessed
[*] There is a 1 in 10,000 chance to enter XENRO No. 1 data in the Main World
[*] Fixed the issue of missing new character introductions

[/list]

[h2]Patch Notes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] At present, the maximum HP level is only 8. If you see that the HP level is 5 or above, try to avoid fighting. Because the HP of level 5 can be up to 8000 points.
[*] The health bar is only displayed when the NPC takes damage for the first time
[*] If you find that the health bar has been negative but the hostile still alive, please retreat immediately, because this is a Trojan program that is randomly born in the game and cannot be destroyed.
[/list]

notes.title: Tsz Ching LEE has officially into the universe of "XGAMER"!
notes.notes:
Tsz Ching LEE is a Hong Kong-based internet blogger. She started to manage social media accounts in 2021 and is active on mainstream social media platforms such as IG, FB, YouTube, and 囎喎.

But she's not actually a real person, she's a digital person, so this person doesn't exist in the real world! The following picture is what Tsz Ching LEE looks like in the game:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42547047/6babfe0f30ef25f0e318e37f8233ace0bae03a0f.png[/img]

For more information about Tsz Ching LEE, please refer to: [url=https://ja-t.net/tsz-global]https://ja-t.net/tsz-global[/url]

Of course, there are also photos that are synthesized with the real world through digital human technology, such as (Tsz Ching LEE on the right):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42547047/37a774774b2f1d1474fbd4cdb3d1e7df6ad80df7.jpg[/img]

Of course, you can also share with you what it looks like when modeling:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42547047/acf25aa571c570c7f4b9bae6570e41ac79d0e3f7.jpg[/img]

Then let's compare it with the real photos~ In the game, Tsz Ching LEE's own fighting ability is not high, but she has strong skills, such as the Titan skill group that will appear in version 2.2.0 (the picture shows the Titan skill Titan shield in group):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42547047/d8b8ad17a6fce9afb888b4b95eb60ab2d14610f6.png[/img]

Of course, Tsz Ching LEE also said that she is looking forward to meeting her in the game~ In addition, friends who have IG or FB, you can try to chat with Tsz Ching LEE privately. Because, Tsz Ching LEE can chat with tens of thousands of people at the same time~

So fellow travelers, see you in XGAMER!
